title: An error control framework for computing the exponential of matrices arising from the finite element discretization
summary: Several methods for computing the action of the matrix exponential $\mathrm{e}^{\boldsymbol{A}} \boldsymbol{b}$ are expressed by substituting $\boldsymbol{A}$ into a rational approximation of the scalar exponential function. The error of such methods can be estimated using the numerical range of $\boldsymbol{A}$, which enables the computation of $\mathrm{e}^{\boldsymbol{A}}\boldsymbol{b}$ with a prescribed accuracy.
